description: pipe-elbow-fuse's pipe pushed into the bend by one and a half tolerances (1e-7) or four, pulled away by four, turned about its cap's middle by a quarter of one or sixteen, or grown by one or two. Arris fails: the torus and the cap's plane, or the pipe's wall, called tangent along a curve (Fault::Geometry, the section is degenerate; one and a half in, four either way, grown by one), turning points it does not tell apart (Fault::Geometry; grown by two), a cycle that does not turn once (Fault::Split, Turn; the quarter turn) and the cap planes with no closed form (OpError::Unsupported; the turn by sixteen). The desired result is a clean union: the flush body within the tolerance, the generic one beyond. Pushed in by one and grown by a half now pass and are boolean/pipe-elbow-fuse-band-ends' (plans/c3-tolerance-apart steps 1 and 9, the band survey)
